---
title: "The representation contract"
---

## Installation

```{r, eval = FALSE}
# Install from CRAN
install.packages("timesift")

# Or install the development version from GitHub
# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("gcol33/timesift")
```

```bash
# Install from PyPI
pip install timesift

# with the torch encoders, the contrasts and the plots
pip install "timesift[torch,contrasts,plot]"

# Or install the development version from GitHub
pip install git+https://github.com/gcol33/timesift
```

```{r, echo = FALSE, results = "asis"}
spec <- readLines(system.file("spec", "representation.md", package = "timesift"),
                  encoding = "UTF-8")
cat(spec[-seq_len(match(TRUE, !grepl("^#|^$", spec)) - 1L)], sep = "\n")
```
